units.source_text: 第三天，发长彦还没开始吹笛子，

en.t: On the third day, before Kaminagahiko had even begun to play the flute,

units.source_text: 一个身材高大的独眼男子如天神般从天而降，

en.t: a tall, large, one-eyed man descended from the sky like a heavenly god,

units.source_text: 男子身上佩戴着红玉，看着他说道：

en.t: the man wore a ruby on his body, looked at him, and said:
I am the one-eyed great immortal of Mount Katsuragi,

units.source_text: 听说我的两位哥哥都来跟你致谢了，

en.t: I heard that both of my elder brothers came to thank you,

units.source_text: 我今天也要送你一条和阿嗅、阿飞不相上下的绝世好狗。”

en.t: today I too will give you a peerless hound no less splendid than Axiu or Afei.

units.source_text: 话音未落，就马上吹了一声震彻森林的口哨，

en.t: Before the words had even left his mouth, he at once blew a whistle that shook the forest,

units.source_text: 召唤来了一条面露獠牙的花斑狗。

en.t: and summoned a spotted dog that bared its fangs.
